reason: The SDK endpoint is project-scoped and accepts a project id, while the spec requires a deployment id.

spec.summary: Show a deployment's environment variables, hiding values stored as secrets.

reason: The SDK writes one project variable per call; the CLI parser cannot accept zero or multiple positional assignments, and the endpoint applies changes on the next deploy rather than restarting immediately.

spec.summary: Add or update selected variables without changing other variables; the deployment restarts to apply them.

args.name: assignments
args.description: Zero or more KEY=VALUE pairs; provide these or a file.

flags.name: file
flags.description: Read assignments from a dotenv-style file.

flags.name: secret
flags.description: Store supplied values as secrets that cannot be read back.

reason: The SDK removes one project variable per call and the CLI parser retains only the last repeated --confirm-key, so multi-key confirmation cannot be represented safely.

spec.summary: Remove the named variables from a deployment; the deployment restarts afterward.

args.name: keys
args.description: One or more exact variable names to remove.

flags.name: confirm-key
flags.description: Repeat once per key and match each key name exactly.

spec.confirm: Repeat --confirm-key for every key being removed; each value must exactly match a target key.

spec.summary: Show the deployment's CPU and memory requests, including when either uses the organization default.

reason: Egg's resource endpoint changes live service CPU and memory limits, while this spec requires per-pod requests.

spec.summary: Change only the supplied CPU or memory request; zero clears that request to its organization default and pods restart.

flags.name: cpu
flags.description: CPU request in millicores; zero restores the default.

flags.name: memory
flags.description: Memory request in bytes or a size unit; zero restores the default.

spec.summary: Show each attached volume and its mount configuration.

reason: The endpoint rejects volume edits because mounts must be changed in the Compose file; the CLI parser also retains only the last repeated --volume flag, so only one mount can be submitted.

spec.summary: Replace the deployment's complete volume list with the supplied mounts; an empty list removes every mount.

flags.name: volume
flags.description: Repeat with mount-path=size for each persistent volume.

flags.name: confirm-deployment
flags.description: Exact deployment name to confirm replacing its full volume list.

spec.confirm: --confirm-deployment must exactly match the deployment name before replacing or removing mounts.

spec.summary: Choose how replacement pods are introduced during deployment updates.

flags.name: type
flags.description: Update strategy: rolling update, recreate, or blue-green.

spec.summary: Pin when the image is downloaded for pod starts, or restore automatic behavior based on its tag.

flags.name: policy
flags.description: Choose automatic behavior, always pull, or pull only when absent.

reason: Egg supports only the health path; the endpoint and CLI lack probe type, enablement, timing, and liveness, readiness, and startup controls.

spec.summary: Update selected health-probe settings while retaining every setting whose flag was omitted.

flags.name: enabled
flags.description: Enable or disable health checks.

flags.name: type
flags.description: Probe kind: HTTP, TCP, or an in-container command.

flags.name: path
flags.description: URL path for an HTTP probe.

flags.name: port
flags.description: Port checked by the probe.

flags.name: command
flags.description: Command used by an execution probe.

flags.name: liveness
flags.description: Enable or disable the liveness probe.

flags.name: readiness
flags.description: Enable or disable the readiness probe.

flags.name: startup
flags.description: Enable or disable the startup probe.

flags.name: interval
flags.description: Seconds between probe attempts.

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: Seconds to wait for each probe.

flags.name: retries
flags.description: Consecutive failures before a probe is unhealthy.

flags.name: startup-failure-threshold
flags.description: Failed startup attempts allowed before stopping the pod.

reason: The SDK can set an application subdirectory but cannot switch the Docker build context to the repository root or configure these build accelerators.

spec.summary: Choose whether a GitHub deployment builds from the repository root or the Dockerfile directory, with optional build-service settings.

args.name: mode
args.description: Use on to build from the repository root or off to use the Dockerfile directory.

flags.name: depot
flags.description: Enable the Depot build service.

flags.name: persistent-cache
flags.description: Keep the build cache between builds.

reason: Egg supports root, install, build, start, and output settings, but lacks build type, Dockerfile path and target, and builder selection; the CLI parser also rejects empty values needed to clear settings.

spec.summary: Change only the supplied build settings; an empty value clears a setting, and changes apply on the next build except the start command.

flags.name: build-type
flags.description: Select Dockerfile or Railpack builds.

flags.name: dockerfile
flags.description: Dockerfile path relative to the repository root.

flags.name: target
flags.description: Multi-stage Docker build target; empty clears the selection.

flags.name: start-cmd
flags.description: Override the image start command; empty uses its configured command.

flags.name: root
flags.description: Railpack application directory inside the repository.

flags.name: install-cmd
flags.description: Override the detected Railpack install step.

flags.name: build-cmd
flags.description: Override the detected Railpack build step.

flags.name: output-dir
flags.description: Railpack directory containing the built static files.

flags.name: builder
flags.description: Select automatic, fast, or standard build execution.
